items.title: Ray Drummond interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: Class of 1964, which also included Diane Wiest... I haven't seen her since graduation.

ctx.x: I’ll be darned, you did a circle?

I did a whole circle through 13 other schools. I started in the back, Nuremberg Elementary School, first grade, and then I graduated in the front twelve years later from Nuremberg Senior High School. So I got the diploma to prove it. Class of 1964, which also included Diane Wiest. She was Colonel Wiest’s daughter. I have my yearbook Nuremberg High School yearbook. I still have it in my house. And on this page I’m sitting there, a full size picture of the outstanding senior in music. Ray Drummond with his French…
Wow, that’d be neat. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
